mainEntity.name: What can go wrong when I use AI to run my small business by myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main risks are inaccurate outputs, invented facts, privacy exposure, inappropriate customer messages, weak source quality, and excessive reliance on automation. Small-business guidance recommends human review, careful handling of proprietary information, attention to intellectual-property concerns, and monitoring customer-facing content. Run My AI Biz’s stated safeguards include approval before sending, publishing, spending, or signing up for services. Do not place confidential customer or business information into a tool unless its terms and settings are suitable for that use. Maintain source links, review claims, restrict permissions, and keep a manual fallback for important processes.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI may produce inaccurate claims, expose sensitive information, create unsuitable messages, or cause costly actions if given too much autonomy. Use source checks, restricted permissions, approval gates, and a manual backup process.
